markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 2 priority flag [F1]; confirm invasion before releasing drafted ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67 stain orders.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Strong score; test ECE 5% |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (10% alpha; 90% test coverage) | Single class at 90% target |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 86% OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical input; quality flag clear |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (84–87% similarity) [F5] | Unanimous neighbors; InSitu contrast 80% |

## Tissue evidence
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 7, 9, 10) · ↑ invasive · High score (+2.21, contribution +0.90) favors invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 7, 8) · ↑ invasive · High score (+1.20, contribution +0.75) supports stromal infiltration [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.69, contribution +0.66; caption inconsistent) favors invasion [F4] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Low score (contribution +0.53), 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Nuclear size** (regions 1, 2, 6) · context · Mean 85 µm² (95th percentile; 52% neoplastic) in 3 regions [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting 3 top-risk regions drops P(invasive) beyond random (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (diff +0.001, CI -0.009 to +0.006); case leans on unreliable normal_lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-grade InSitu (contrast BACH_0155, 80% similarity) mimics invasion; separating concepts duct_confined (12/20 Weak) and normal_lobules (0/20 Unreliable) underperform.
- OOD percentile is 86%, reliability AUROC is 0.70, and HoVer-Net sampled only 3 of 12 regions.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 6, 7, 8**: Confirm stromal invasion (100% risk in 6, 8) before releasing ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67.
2. **Regions 1, 2, 6, 7, 9, 10**: Verify nuclear pleomorphism (7, 9, 10) and enlarged neoplastic nuclei (1, 2, 6).
3. **Regions 1, 3**: Check duct confinement (region 1) and tubule loss (region 3) to exclude InSitu.
